artworks.title: Figures on a Monumental Interior Stairway [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image contains a series of gentle, curving lines and soft shading that create an abstract representation of an internal architectural space. The shapes suggest the structure of an arched passageway or arcade. Figures are lightly sketched, appearing as silhouettes or shadows. The interplay of lines and forms may bring to mind the concept of movement within an architectural setting.

artworks.title: Kneeling Figure in a Hooded Robe [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of a person wearing a loose cloak, partially obscuring their body. The figure seems to be kneeling or crouching. Their face is lightly depicted, with medium-length hair partly covered by the cloak. The clothing is a draped garment covering the person entirely. There are no visible accessories or items held by the individual. The background is a plain, light-colored surface.

artworks.title: Two Women Seen from Behind
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a pencil sketch of two people shown from the back, standing close together. They are wearing long dresses, shawls, and hats with frills or decorations. The figures' clothing appears layered, adding texture. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Man with a Walking Stick, Seen in Profile [recto]
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 13.7 x 10.2 cm (5 3/8 x 4 in.)
support: 21.5 x 15.6 cm (8 7/16 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a person standing sideways, facing left, with one arm outstretched and the other bent at the elbow. They have minimal facial features, short curly hair, and wear a long coat and a brimmed hat. The clothing details are simple with no jewelry or objects. The background is plain with a textured, light surface.

artworks.title: Buildings along a Riverside [verso]
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 13 x 9.5 cm (5 1/8 x 3 3/4 in.)
support: 15.6 x 21.5 cm (6 1/8 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch depicting a series of steps leading towards a waterfront. The horizon is low in the composition, with buildings lining it and extending into the distance on the right side of the sketch. The architecture shows classical style, featuring arched windows and detailed facades. The artist uses light, wispy pencil lines for forms and more pronounced strokes for defining the steps and building outlines. There is a small boat nearby and buildings in the distance. The sketch is monochromatic in varying shades of gray against a light background.

artworks.title: Statue of Alexander and Bucephalus [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular nude figure holding a cloth in a dynamic pose. The drawing captures the essence of movement and muscle tension. The sketch is done in pencil or charcoal, evident from the various shades of grey and the use of line to convey form and depth. This composition suggests a classical theme with a focus on the human form, emphasizing anatomy and the natural flow of the human body. The loose lines and shading give a sense of fluidity and energy to the figure.

artworks.title: Two Studies of the Statue of Alexander and Bucephalus [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two human figures. Both figures are shown from head to toe. The first figure on the left faces slightly to the right with arms raised and head tilted upward. The second figure on the right faces left with one arm raised. Facial features are minimally depicted, and the hair is roughly indicated with simple lines. Both figures appear nude. The background is plain with no discernible details or scenery.

artworks.title: Statue of Jupiter, Seated [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a bearded male figure sitting with a raised arm. The figure has a muscular torso, curly hair, and is draped in flowing garments. The figure's facial features include a full beard, and the raised arm appears to be holding an object. The drawing is done in pencil with defined lines on a plain background with an outlined border.

artworks.title: Woman in Toga [verso]
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 15 x 9 cm (5 7/8 x 3 9/16 in.)
support: 21.5 x 15.6 cm (8 7/16 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch displays a full-length figure of a person standing in a gentle, fluid pose. The individual is shown in a classical draped stance, with one arm extended forward and the other near the chest. The facial features are softly sketched, with a slightly tilted head. The person's hair is styled in a swept-back manner. They are dressed in traditional draped garments with no visible jewelry or objects held. In the background, a lightly sketched architectural element or column is visible. The image is drawn in soft pencil on a plain background, highlighting the lines and folds of the clothing.

artworks.title: Woman and Smaller Male Figure on Grand Stairway [recto]
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of two figures. The first figure is depicted standing with a slight lean to one side. The second figure stands slightly behind and to the side of the first figure, with a casual posture. Both figures are surrounded by shading lines that suggest a vertical background.

artworks.title: Two Seated Women with Male Figure between Them [verso]
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 13.5 x 9.8 cm (5 5/16 x 3 7/8 in.)
support: 21.5 x 15.6 cm (8 7/16 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch depicts three figures in a side-profile view. There is an adult, possibly female, seated with a child on her lap, while another adult stands or sits next to them. The seated figure with the child is angled slightly towards the standing figure. The outlines of the figures are drawn in delicate pencil strokes. The adult female has long hair styled upwards or is wearing a hat, with features subtly indicated by the pencil lines. She is dressed in a garment with puff sleeves and potential decorative elements. The child has a circular head and basic features, leaning against the seated figure. The composition suggests a serene moment between them. The background is blank, emphasizing the foreground figures.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a partial sketch of a person's head and neck in a side profile, with simple outlines of facial features, hair tied back, and some curls visible. Minimal clothing details are shown around the neck. The background is plain and light-colored.

artworks.title: Bust of a Roman Woman and Statue of a Roman Man
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features two pencil sketches. The first sketch on the left shows a profile view of a bust with a head and partial shoulders. The facial features are depicted, including eyebrows, a nose, and lips. The hair is styled back. The second sketch on the right shows a full-body view of a standing figure in draped fabric, holding a piece of cloth with one hand raised. Simple objects are sketched near the figure's feet. Both sketches are on an off-white background with faint discolorations.

artworks.title: Statue of a Nude before a Window View
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows intersecting and overlapping lines creating an abstract representation. In the center, a figure stands upright on a rectangular pedestal, resembling a classical statue. To the right, an outline suggests an architectural dome. Below the figure, rounded forms and lines imply smaller, seated figures, resembling an audience or gathering.

artworks.title: Two Statues of Male Nudes
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 14.9 x 10 cm (5 7/8 x 3 15/16 in.)
support: 21.5 x 15.6 cm (8 7/16 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures of nude individuals. One figure on the left is standing in a relaxed pose with one arm slightly raised, the other resting by its side, and one leg slightly bent. This figure appears to be leaning against an abstract form resembling a tree trunk or pillar. The other figure on the right has one arm raised above the head and the other bending outward at the elbow. Both figures have facial features with soft lines for the nose and mouth, and indicated hair styles. The focus is on the outline and musculature of the human form. The background is plain without additional elements.

artworks.title: Statue of Zeus Holding a Thunderbolt
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a standing person with a slightly forward-leaning posture and one arm extended outward. The figure has long hair flowing past the shoulders, possible facial hair, and is wearing loose, classical robes that cover one shoulder and extend down to the feet. There are no visible jewelry or items being held, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Interior of a Roman Palace
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior architectural scene. The drawing depicts a grand, arched interior space. The viewer's eye is led into the space by a series of columns and arches. The drawing uses light and shadow to emphasize the architectural elements such as the columns and the arches. To the right, a niche houses a statue. The perspective and shading techniques provide a sense of scale and craftsmanship, capturing the grandeur of the architecture.

artworks.title: Statue of Cleopatra
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a person in a reclining position. The person is lying on their side, with one arm raised above their head and the other arm resting beside their body. The facial features are minimally detailed, and the hair is draped around the head and shoulders. The person is shown with cloth covering parts of the lower body and the upper torso more exposed. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, and the sketch is set against a simple, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Group of Male Figures Conversing
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 12.4 x 10.1 cm (4 7/8 x 4 in.)
support: 21.5 x 15.6 cm (8 7/16 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in motion. The sketch features multiple figures, drawn with quick and loose lines. Some of the figures appear to be holding swords. The style of the drawing conveys a sense of dynamic movement and energy, with emphasis on flowing drapery and expressive postures. The use of charcoal or pencil adds depth with varying shades and textures.

artworks.title: S. Rocco
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of architectural structures from a frontal perspective, showcasing symmetry. The horizon is indistinct, with an emphasis on a slope leading to the buildings. A large dome stands out at the center of the complex of structures extending across the scene. The sketch features loose, fluid pencil strokes indicating form and shadow rather than explicit details, which creates depth and texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray from the pencil on a simple background. Steps in the foreground lead upwards, while architectural details in the distance, such as a smaller dome and vertical lines, add depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Italian City Scene
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This pencil sketch depicts a scene of rustic architecture from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is at the top of the drawing, with trees and simple structures in the foreground. Two large building-like forms are prominent, one on the left and one on the right. Lines suggest smaller structures or a courtyard area between them. The monochromatic palette uses varying shades of graphite for depth. The pencil strokes are light and confident, detailing the forms and shading subtly to capture mass and space.

artworks.title: Seated Male Nude with Arm over Head, Seen from the Side
artworks.dimensions:

support: 15.6 x 21.5 cm (6 1/8 x 8 7/16 in.)

artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a seated figure with a bent posture, indistinct facial features, dark wavy hair, and no clothing. The background is minimal with shading behind the figure.

artworks.title: Young Woman's Head in Profile
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sketch depicts a profile view of a person's upper body, from the chest upwards. The individual is facing sideways to the left. Their facial features are delicately outlined, with a prominent nose and a subtle smile. The eyes are minimally detailed, and the hair is styled elaborately with decorative elements resembling ribbons or bows. Simple lines suggest clothing, possibly a collar or upper garment. The background is plain and unadorned, directing focus to the drawing's subject.

artworks.title: Little Girl with a Large Basket
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person holding a large basket. The person is slightly hunched forward. The facial features are minimally detailed, with a general outline of the face, eyes, and a mouth. The person's hair seems to be pulled back or covered by a bonnet or hat. The clothing includes a long-sleeved top and a long skirt or apron. The sketch is set on a plain background.
